context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 尋常/行き着く/電報/航路/探知/重傷/覇権/代議士

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、尋常ではない、絶対、状況、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Sakura, your treatment of wartime in that paper was really impressive — the scope you brought to it.
lines.style: Warm recognition, leaning forward slightly. Speaking with the careful attentiveness of a teacher who has read something that surprised her. Genuine appreciation in the lift at 'impressive.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、最終的に、絶対、行き着く、絶対、結論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to follow where the history actually led — trace it through to what the research really showed. It felt important to do it thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet, measured sincerity. Looking at the teacher directly. Speaking with the steadiness of someone defending work she believes in, not defensively but with understated conviction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、電報、絶対、家族、絶対、悲しい知らせ、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The way you wove in those personal details — the telegrams to families, the weight of that news — it showed real depth of understanding.
lines.style: Reflective, almost speaking to herself first. Thoughtful pause before 'depth.' The tone of someone noticing something she didn't expect to find.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、敵国の航路、絶対、避けて、絶対、船、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: That part mattered to me. Understanding how people actually navigated it — which routes they took, what they had to avoid. The human choices underneath the history.
lines.style: Earnest without being heavy. Speaking with quiet conviction, like she's explaining something she cares about. No apology in the voice, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、敵の探知、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: You did that. The way you handled the detection systems, the technological side of it — it's all woven in so naturally.
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath the professionalism. A small smile in the voice. The tone of someone who teaches and occasionally finds a student who makes her work feel worth it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、市民の重傷、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. There were parts that were hard to write about — the civilian casualties especially. But I thought that had to be there. It had to be part of the story.
lines.style: Quieter here. Not cheerful, but steady. Speaking with the kind of seriousness that comes from sitting with difficult material. Respectful of the weight of what she's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、覇権主義、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: I noticed that in how you handled the ideology — you didn't simplify it or turn it into a sermon. You let readers see the complexity.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Speaking slowly, like the words need room to land. Genuine respect underneath — the kind that comes from recognizing a student doing real work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、代議士の苦悩、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I tried to show what it was like for the people who had to make those choices — the Diet members, especially. Their impossible positions. That felt like the real story.
lines.style: Grounded and direct. Speaking with the quiet intensity of someone who has thought this through. No flourish, just clear commitment to what she was trying to say.
